A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work, Towards Scalable Topological Regularizers. All 31 pages in each version, including Appendices A–H, are readable and support comparison of text, equations, tables and figures.

before.justification: v1 reports original shape-matching experiments, computational timings, image-generation evaluations and semi-supervised classification results in Section 6 and Appendices E–G.

after.justification: v2 retains those original empirical results, including the additional image-generation and SVHN experiments in the appendices.

M1.justification: The PPM-Reg procedure, subsampling, persistence-weighted MMD kernel, combination of homology dimensions and GAN objectives are unchanged. The network architectures in Appendix H are also identical.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate circle/intersecting-circle shape matching; image generation using AnimeFace, CelebA and LSUN Kitchen; and classification using MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, Kuzushiji-MNIST and SVHN. The appendix experiments and test scenarios are retained.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: Cramer and MMD in shape matching, W-PPM-Reg and PD-Reg in timing comparisons, Cramer in image generation, and Baseline and Cramer in semi-supervised classification.

E3.justification: Evaluation settings remain identical, including image resolutions, 10K-image metric calculations, minimum-CMMD epoch selection, classification label budgets, training schedules and network configurations. No protocol is added or revised.

E4.justification: Both retain the imperfect-convergence experiment in Appendix E.2, regularization-strength and kernel-width studies in Tables 4–5, 7–9 and 11, and qualitative examples. No ablation, robustness test or supplementary analysis changes.

E5.justification: The stated ten-run timing and classification evaluations and their average/error-bar reporting are unchanged, including the appendix classification studies. No seed information or statistical procedure is added.

E6.justification: All result entries in Tables 1–11 and the empirical figures are unchanged. For example, Table 2 retains AnimeFace CMMD values of 0.73 for Cramer and 0.56 for Cramer + PPM-Reg; Table 10 retains 57.20 ± 1.51% for Cramer + PPM-Reg with 400 SVHN labels.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, assumptions, theorem statements and derivations are identical, including the characteristic-kernel, topology-equivalence and continuous-gradient proofs in Appendices A–D.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about scalable topological regularization, continuous gradients under smoothness assumptions, and effectiveness across the three experimental applications.

C2.justification: Interpretations and qualifications are unchanged, including the explanation of initial topological-distance spikes, the cost of CMMD-based epoch selection, and the conjecture connecting LSUN Kitchen improvements to more complex topology.

D1.justification: Section 6, footnote 4 replaces the OpenReview code-and-supplement pointer with the GitHub repository htwong-ai/ScalableTopologicalRegularizers. This changes access instructions; the PDFs do not establish newly released resources. Implementation details, hyperparameters and hardware disclosures remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works, reference list and research positioning are unchanged, including the relationship to prior PPM and persistence-kernel work and the novelty claim for the continuous-gradient theorem.

P1.justification: v2 expands and revises the affiliations, adds the ICLR 2025 publication statement, and shortens the resource-footnote wording. The scientific prose, terminology and section/appendix organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: v2 adds publication headers and reflows the opening pages following the expanded affiliation block, shifting Figure 1 downward. All eleven figures and eleven tables retain their content, design and captions.

improvement.justification: The scientific exposition, methods, proofs and empirical evidence, including all appendices, are unchanged. v2 updates affiliations, publication formatting and the existing resource pointer. These limited administrative and access edits do not materially change the paper's overall quality.
